column1: Inland Revenue (Amendment)
Act, No. 10 of 2021

column2: “11. Tax rate for persons who engage in agro

column1: farming  together  with  agro  processing  or
manufacturing.

column2: Where a person utilizes agro farming produce

column1: produced  by  him  for  his  agro  processing  or
manufacturing business activity in Sri Lanka, such
portion of the tax payable in respect of such agro
processing or manufacturing business activity that
corresponds  to  the  proportion  of  the  farming
produce  produced  by  him  to  the  total  farming
produce  utilized  in  such  agro  processing  or
manufacturing, shall be reduced by twenty-five per
centum, for the period of five years of assessment
commencing on April 1, 2021.

column2: 12.    Application  of  tax  rates  for  different

column1: gains and profits.

column2: Where a person’s taxable income consists of

column1: different sources of income or gains and profits from
different  business  activities,  the  income  tax  rates
applicable to each such source of income or such
gains  and  profits  from  such  different  business
activities shall be applied to such source of income
or such gains and profits.”.
